Why Suzhou?

China’s most innovative industrial park — where global talent meets world-class infrastructure, just 30 minutes from Shanghai.

Reason 01

Strategic Location

Just 30 minutes from Shanghai by high-speed rail, Suzhou sits in the heart of the Yangtze River Delta — China’s most economically dynamic region. You get all the advantages of proximity to China’s financial capital without the premium costs.

  • 30 min to Shanghai by high-speed rail
  • Direct access to Yangtze River Delta markets
  • Proximity to two international airports
Reason 02

Government Support

Suzhou Industrial Park offers some of the most generous startup subsidies, tax incentives, and talent programs in China, specifically designed for overseas entrepreneurs. The local government is actively committed to attracting international talent.

  • Generous startup subsidies and grants
  • Special tax incentives for OPC-registered businesses
  • Talent program eligibility for overseas founders
Reason 03

Low Cost of Living

Compared to Shanghai and Beijing, Suzhou offers significantly lower living and operating costs while maintaining world-class infrastructure and amenities. Your startup budget goes much further here — from office rent to daily expenses.

  • Office rent 50–70% lower than Shanghai
  • Affordable housing and daily living costs
  • World-class infrastructure at lower prices

Reason 04

Innovation Ecosystem

Home to over 100 R&D centers, SIP is a hub for AI, biotechnology, new energy, and advanced manufacturing. The OPC ecosystem alliance connects 12 key domains, giving your startup immediate access to cutting-edge research and industry partners.

  • 100+ R&D centers across key industries
  • 12-domain OPC ecosystem alliance
  • AI, biotech, and new energy focus areas
Reason 05

International Community

A growing community of expatriates and international businesses. Suzhou has a welcoming environment with international schools, healthcare, and cultural amenities. You’ll feel at home while building your business in China.

  • International schools and healthcare
  • Vibrant expat networking community
  • Cultural amenities and lifestyle options
Reason 06

Talent Pool

Access to graduates from top universities in Suzhou, Shanghai, and Nanjing. SIP partners with universities for talent recruitment and internship programs, giving your startup a pipeline of skilled professionals in technology, engineering, and business.

  • Top-tier university graduate pipeline
  • University partnership internship programs
  • Bilingual talent in tech and business

Financial Incentives for OPC Entrepreneurs in SIP

Suzhou Industrial Park offers some of China’s most generous government grants for foreign entrepreneurs. Moon Bay OPC helps you identify and apply for every program you qualify for.

Startup Funding

The Jinji Lake Leading Talent Program provides staged startup capital for qualified tech entrepreneurs — the single largest grant available to OPC founders in SIP.

The Jinji Lake program explicitly encourages AI-powered OPC entrepreneurs to apply. We guide our clients through the entire application process — from eligibility check to final submission.

Jiangsu Province has also issued 18 dedicated support measures for AI OPCs at the provincial level — including a 100B RMB credit facility and computing subsidies.
